text: What if all humans vanished and time sped up?
formula: title question word for word (STANDARD 1.3). Counter = time since humans vanished, shown on a log timeline bar from 1 second to 10 billion years.

text: Eight billion people. Gone in one second.
formula: LEAN: world population passed 8 billion on 15 Nov 2022 (UN) and is ~8.2 billion in 2025-26 (UN World Population Prospects 2024) -> 'eight billion'.

text: But the chess game isn't over. It's the Pigeon's move.
formula: SNAPBACK + opening problem (STANDARD 0.14): animals don't vanish, so Mittens and the Pigeon are still at the board; the Pigeon has to move. Paid off by n13.

text: You were the referee. You vanished mid-game.
formula: blame, set up on screen: you sit at the table holding the chess clock with a REFEREE tag; your clothes-free chair and the clock drop when you vanish.

text: Now nobody fixes anything. No power. No pumps.
formula: physics/why: power plants need operators and fuel deliveries; without them grids trip offline within hours to a couple of days (Weisman, The World Without Us, 2007; History 'Life After People' 2008). Milestone 1 DAY = LIGHTS OUT (1/365 = 0.00274 yr).

text: Two days. The subway is full of water.
formula: New York pumps ~13 million gallons a day out of its subway; with the pumps off the tunnels flood within ~36 hours, 'after just two days... flooded' (Weisman via NPR 7 Sep 2007; MTA figure). Milestone 2 DAYS = SUBWAYS FLOOD.

text: Forty years. Trees everywhere, like near Chernobyl.
formula: 1 YEAR = WEEDS IN THE CRACKS (freeze-thaw cracks pavement, seeds root in the cracks in the first seasons; Weisman). 40 YEARS: Pripyat, the town 3 km from Chernobyl, was evacuated in April 1986; 2026 - 1986 = 40 years and its streets are now forest.

text: Roofs cave in. Rain does the rest.
formula: Weisman (Living on Earth interview, 2007): an unattended roof goes 'within 50, a maximum of 100 years'; once it is gone water rots the rest. Milestone 100 YEARS = ROOFS COLLAPSE. 500 YEARS = A FOREST (Weisman: residential neighbourhoods become forests within 500 years).

text: A thousand years. Only stone is left.
formula: Weisman (LOE 2007): 'a thousand years out I don't think there'd be many buildings standing except for some of the original ones that were made of stone'; glass-and-steel towers will have fallen. Milestone 1,000 YEARS = ONLY STONE STANDS (our stone clock tower).

Weisman: eventually the next glacier scrapes the city away. Timing: Ganopolski, Winkelmann & Schellnhuber (Nature 529, 2016): with today's added CO2 the next glacial inception is delayed to ~50,000-100,000 years from now. Milestone 100,000 YEARS = ICE AGE.

Scotese (Paleomap Project): the next supercontinent, Pangaea Proxima/Ultima, forms in ~250 million years as the Atlantic closes (also Farnsworth et al., Nature Geoscience 2023). Milestone 250 MILLION YEARS = ONE SUPERCONTINENT.

text: The Sun gets hotter. The oceans boil away.
formula: The Sun brightens ~10% per billion years; in ~1 billion years the habitable zone moves past Earth and the oceans evaporate (Schroder & Smith 2008 via Universe Today). Milestone 1 BILLION YEARS = OCEANS GONE.

text: Then the Sun swells up. Red and huge.
formula: The Sun runs out of hydrogen in its core in ~5 billion years and starts to grow into a red giant (NASA; Schroder & Smith 2008). Milestone 5 BILLION YEARS = SUN SWELLS.

text: Well. It's still the Pigeon's move.
formula: callback ending (pays off n2), said while the red giant reaches Earth: Schroder & Smith (MNRAS 386, 2008): the Sun engulfs Earth at ~7.59 billion years, near the tip of the red-giant branch (radius ~256x today). Milestone 7.6 BILLION YEARS = SUN SWALLOWS EARTH. The counter keeps climbing to the last frame.

text: Which building in your city would last the longest?
formula: closing question: specific to this video, answerable with the viewer's own guess (STANDARD 1.9).
